headline: Tinubu cuts 2026 budget to N65.18tn, retains deficit
summary: President Bola Tinubu asked the House to re-enact the 2026 budget, reducing it from N68.32tn to N65.18tn. The fiscal deficit of N31.46tn and N29.22tn in borrowing are retained.
why: Nigeria's budget sets government spending and borrowing needs, which affect the naira, sovereign debt and bond yields that foreign and domestic investors track.
